CALL_SCRIPTS.title: Standard Greeting
CALL_SCRIPTS.text:
"Good morning / afternoon. Thank you for calling LIFE Slimming & Cosmetic Clinics. My name is [Agent Name]. How can I help you today?"

✅ AGENT NOTE: Speak clearly, smile (it shows in your voice), and use the client's name as soon as they give it. Always sound warm and welcoming.

CALL_SCRIPTS.title: Appointment Booking — 5-Step Flow
CALL_SCRIPTS.text:
1. "Certainly! May I know your name, please?"
2. "Thank you, [Name]. Can I have your best mobile number for confirmation?"
3. "Which of our branches is most convenient for you?"
4. "Would you prefer a weekday or weekend? Morning or afternoon?"
5. "Perfect, [Name]. Your priority consultation is successfully booked for [Day] at [Time] at our [Branch] clinic. We will send the address details via WhatsApp shortly."

✅ AGENT NOTE: Always confirm all 5 steps before ending the call.

CALL_SCRIPTS.title: Price Enquiry Bridge
CALL_SCRIPTS.text:
Client asks: "How much does it cost?"

Agent: "I completely understand wanting to know the pricing, [Name]. At LIFE, all our treatments are customized. Because costs depend entirely on your specific concern, BMI, or skin type, our doctor needs to do a quick evaluation first to give you an accurate budget.

The good news is we can get you scheduled for an expert doctor consultation this week. Shall we check available slots?"

✅ AGENT NOTE: Never quote prices over the phone. Always bridge to the consultation.

CALL_SCRIPTS.title: Follow-Up Call Opening
CALL_SCRIPTS.text:
"Hello, am I speaking with [Client Name]? This is [Agent Name] calling from LIFE Slimming & Cosmetic Clinics.

I'm following up regarding your earlier enquiry about [Treatment]. I just wanted to check whether you had any questions I could help with, and to let you know we have some excellent availability this week for your doctor consultation."

✅ AGENT NOTE: Sound warm, not salesy. Reference their specific interest to show you know them.

CALL_SCRIPTS.title: No Answer Script
CALL_SCRIPTS.text:
If no answer after 3 rings:
"This is [Agent Name] from LIFE Clinics. I'm calling regarding your [Treatment] enquiry. Please call us back at [CC Number] at your convenience. Alternatively, I'll try again [specific time/day]. Thank you!"

✅ AGENT NOTE: Leave a maximum 1 voicemail. Attempt the call 3 times before marking as "No Response."

CALL_SCRIPTS.title: Existing Client Handling
CALL_SCRIPTS.text:
"That's wonderful, [Name]! I'm glad you're already part of the LIFE family. I'm calling today because based on your previous treatment, our consultant thought you might benefit from our [specific complementary treatment/package renewal].

Would you be open to a quick chat with our doctor to explore this? There's no obligation — it's just to keep your progress on track."

✅ AGENT NOTE: Focus on cross-sell or renewal — never hard sell existing clients.

CALL_SCRIPTS.title: Complaint / Escalation
CALL_SCRIPTS.text:
"I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you've experienced, [Name]. Your comfort and satisfaction are our highest priority.

I'm making a note of your concern right now and I'll ensure this reaches our [Branch Manager / Medical Head] immediately. You can expect a callback within [2 hours / by today evening]. Thank you for bringing this to our attention."

✅ AGENT NOTE: Do not argue. Do not make promises about refunds without manager approval. Always escalate complaints to TL.

CALL_SCRIPTS.title: Consultation Close
CALL_SCRIPTS.text:
"So based on everything you've told me, [Name], I think you'll really benefit from meeting our doctor. It's a completely free, no-obligation session where they'll assess your exact concern and give you a customized plan.

We have slots on [Day] morning and [Day] afternoon. Which works better for you?"

✅ AGENT NOTE: Always present 2 choices (not "do you want an appointment?") to make it easier for the client to say yes.

OBJECTIONS.obj: It's too costly / What are your charges?
OBJECTIONS.response: I completely understand, [Name]. At LIFE, our treatments are 100% customized — so the cost really depends on your specific condition and what our doctor recommends. What I can tell you is that we have options across all budgets, including installment plans. The first step — a doctor consultation — is the most important. Once our doctor meets you, you'll have a clear picture of exactly what's needed and what it costs. Shall we book that for you?
OBJECTIONS.tip: Never quote prices. Bridge to consultation.

OBJECTIONS.obj: I need to discuss with my family / husband / wife
OBJECTIONS.response: Absolutely, [Name] — that's a very sensible approach, and we completely respect that. In fact, we warmly welcome family members to join you for the consultation. That way, the doctor can address all questions together, and the whole family has clarity. I'll book you a slot — you can always cancel or reschedule if needed. There's no pressure at all.
OBJECTIONS.tip: Validate the family dynamic. Invite them along.

OBJECTIONS.obj: I need some time / Let me think
OBJECTIONS.response: Of course, [Name] — completely understood. Can I ask what specific thing you'd like to think about? If there's any concern about the treatment, safety, or pricing, I'd love to address it right now so you have all the information you need to decide. Most people find that a single 15-minute doctor consultation clarifies everything for them. Shall I book one for you?
OBJECTIONS.tip: Identify the REAL objection. Offer the consultation as the solution.

OBJECTIONS.obj: I'm already taking treatment somewhere else
OBJECTIONS.response: That's completely fine, [Name] — it's great to know you're proactive about your health! We occasionally see clients who come to us for a second opinion or to try a different approach. Would you be open to a quick consultation with our doctor? There's no pressure — you might just find a better result is possible for you. We are very confident in our technology and results.
OBJECTIONS.tip: Never criticize the competitor. Focus on curiosity and a free 2nd opinion.

OBJECTIONS.response: Your safety is our absolute first priority, [Name]. I completely understand the concern. All our treatments are doctor-supervised, clinically approved, and non-invasive. In fact, our doctor specifically evaluates your health history before recommending anything, so nothing is done without a proper assessment. Would you feel more comfortable meeting the doctor in person to understand the procedure in detail? That usually helps a lot.
OBJECTIONS.tip: Reassure safety. Offer a face-to-face doctor explanation.

OBJECTIONS.obj: I'll call you back / Will call later
OBJECTIONS.response: Of course, [Name]! When would be a good time for me to call you back so I don't miss you? I just want to make sure we hold a slot for you — our doctors' consultation availability fills up quickly, especially on weekends. If it works, I can book a provisional slot now and we can always adjust the time if needed.
OBJECTIONS.tip: Pin down a specific callback time. Offer a provisional booking.

OBJECTIONS.obj: I need a discount / Can you give any offer?
OBJECTIONS.response: I completely hear you, [Name]. I want to be honest with you — our treatments are already priced very competitively for the quality and technology we offer. However, what I CAN do is check with my team lead whether there's any current program or offer applicable to your case. Sometimes first-time consultation packages have some additional benefits. Shall I check and call you back in 10 minutes?
OBJECTIONS.tip: Never promise unauthorized discounts. Escalate to TL.

OBJECTIONS.response: I absolutely understand — everyone is busy! That's actually WHY our process is designed to be as efficient as possible. Our initial doctor consultation is typically 15–20 minutes. We have early morning slots (10 AM), lunchtime slots, and even evening slots (up to 7 PM). Which day of the week usually works better for you — a weekday or weekend?
OBJECTIONS.tip: Remove the time barrier. Show flexibility across the entire day.

FAQS.q: What is the best treatment for weight loss?
FAQS.a: Our doctor assesses your BMI, lifestyle, and hormonal health to design a customized plan. This can include clinical diet setups, fat-reduction technologies, or doctor-prescribed GLP-1 medical therapies. First step is a body composition analysis at the clinic.

FAQS.q: What is GLP-1 Weight Loss Injection?
FAQS.a: GLP-1 is an advanced, doctor-prescribed medical weight management treatment that naturally regulates appetite, reduces cravings, and helps you feel full faster. Only prescribed after doctor reviews your medical history.

FAQS.q: What is Inch Loss and how does it work?
FAQS.a: Inch loss targets stubborn localized fat pockets (belly, love handles, arms) to reshape body contour. You can lose dress sizes even before your scale weight drops significantly.
A premium, non-surgical treatment that permanently freezes and destroys stubborn fat cells. Over following weeks, the body naturally flushes dead fat cells out. Ideal for targeted body shaping.
No, CoolSculpting is specifically an inch loss and body sculpting treatment for stubborn areas, not a major weight-loss solution. For weight loss, our medical programs are recommended.

FAQS.q: How many kilos will I lose?
FAQS.a: Because every body is unique, results vary. For Weight Loss, our doctors set realistic, healthy targets tailored to your BMI. During consultation, body fat analysis is done to show you an exact timeline. Shall we book that slot today?
Yes, all our treatments are doctor-supervised and clinically approved. We do not use any unauthorized injections or unsafe methods. Safety is our first priority.

PRP stands for Platelet-Rich Plasma. We draw a small sample of your own blood, separate the nutrient-dense platelets, and gently inject them into your scalp to control hair fall and strengthen weak roots.

GFC is next-generation advancement over standard PRP. It extracts and delivers pure, highly concentrated growth factors directly. Completely precise, highly effective, and usually requires fewer sessions.

FAQS.q: What is the difference between PRP and GFC?
FAQS.a: PRP delivers platelets + growth factors. GFC delivers only pure, extracted growth factors — making it more potent, with faster results and higher comfort. GFC usually requires fewer sessions and gives better outcomes.

FAQS.q: When will I see results from PRP / GFC?
FAQS.a: For PRP and GFC, most clients notice significant reduction in active hair fall after 2nd or 3rd session. New hair thickness and scalp coverage become visible around the 3rd to 4th month of consistent treatment.

The procedure involves micro-injections into the scalp. A numbing cream is applied beforehand to minimize discomfort. Most clients describe it as a mild tingling sensation. GFC is generally more comfortable than standard PRP.

FAQS.q: How many sessions of PRP are needed?
FAQS.a: Typically 6 to 8 sessions are recommended, once every 2–4 weeks, followed by maintenance sessions. Your trichologist will advise based on the degree of hair loss.

FAQS.q: Who is an ideal candidate for Hair Transplant?
FAQS.a: Anyone experiencing permanent baldness or structural hairline receding, provided they have a healthy "donor area" of hair at the back or sides of the head.

FAQS.q: What are the different HT methods?
FAQS.a: FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction): Individual follicles extracted one by one — no linear scars, fast healing. DHI (Direct Hair Implantation): Ultra-precise implanter pen for perfect angle, depth, density. FUT (Strip Method): Traditional method for high-volume graft needs — selected cases only.
Yes, transplanted hairs from the donor area are genetically resistant to DHT (the hormone that causes baldness), so they grow permanently in their new location.
Yes, women can undergo Hair Transplant, particularly for frontal hairline receding or traction alopecia. Our doctor will evaluate the pattern and eligibility during consultation.

FAQS.q: When will I see final results from HT?
FAQS.a: Transplanted roots settle in first month. Permanent natural growth begins around 3rd month. Full, high-density results appear between 9 to 12 months.
A premium multi-step medical facial that deeply cleanses, exfoliates, painlessly extracts blackheads, and infuses skin with intense hydrating serums for instant glowing complexion.

Commonly called the Hollywood Peel — liquid carbon is dried onto the face, then a specialized laser is used. Delivers instant skin brightening, tightens open pores, controls excess oil, and clears surface debris.
Yes. Our doctors customize treatments based on acne severity. Options range from medicated clinical peels to advanced acne-target lasers that eliminate bacteria and reduce active breakouts.

FAQS.q: Can dark pigmentation and melasma be removed?
FAQS.a: Most hyperpigmentation can be significantly lightened and cleared. Our doctor will examine it under a specialized skin analyzer to recommend the perfect laser or peel protocol.
Uses your own natural growth factors to stimulate collagen production deep within skin. Drastically improves skin texture, minimizes fine lines, heals acne scars, and brings back a youthful glow.
High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound — a completely non-invasive treatment that uses ultrasound energy to tighten sagging skin, lift the jawline, and rebuild deep collagen. No surgery, no downtime.
A safe, micro-injectable treatment by expert doctors that relaxes targeted facial muscles to smooth away dynamic expression lines like forehead wrinkles, frown lines, and crow's feet.
A smooth hydrating gel that restores lost volume — lifts cheeks, plumps thin lips, or fills deep folds for an instant youth boost. Different from Botox which treats wrinkles.
It offers long-lasting, permanent reduction of hair growth by up to 85–90%. Over time, any remaining hair becomes baby-fine. Occasional maintenance sessions ensure perfectly smooth skin.

FAQS.q: How many sessions of Laser Hair Removal are needed?
FAQS.a: Typically 6–8 sessions are needed, spaced 4–6 weeks apart, because the laser targets only active growth phase hair. Your doctor will advise based on your skin and hair type.

FAQS.q: Is Laser safe for dark skin?
FAQS.a: Yes! We use advanced Diode Laser technology which is safe and effective for all skin tones, including dark Indian skin types. Our doctors carefully calibrate the settings.

All our treatments are customized — costs depend on your specific concern, body mass index, or skin type. Our doctor needs to do a quick evaluation first to give you an accurate budget. The good news is we can schedule you for an expert doctor consultation this week!
Yes, we offer easy payment options including EMI and installment plans. Our counsellor at the branch will explain the exact options available for your treatment package.

Most patients with well-controlled diabetes can undergo our treatments after doctor evaluation. Our doctor will review your blood sugar levels, medications, and treatment history before recommending any procedure.
Yes, but it depends on thyroid control. Our doctors specialize in designing weight loss programs for thyroid patients, accounting for metabolic differences. First step is a medical history review.

FAQS.q: Is there a doctor consultation before treatment?
FAQS.a: Yes, absolutely. Every treatment at LIFE Clinics begins with a thorough doctor consultation. No treatment is started without proper medical evaluation.

FAQS.q: What are the branch working hours?
FAQS.a: All branches operate from 9:30 AM to 7:30 PM, Monday to Saturday. For Sunday availability, please check with your specific branch.

TREATMENT_KB.name: Weight Loss Program
TREATMENT_KB.purpose: Medical, supervised weight reduction combining doctor consultation, clinical diet, lifestyle modification, and advanced body technologies.
TREATMENT_KB.suitableFor: Individuals with BMI > 23, metabolic disorders, PCOD-related weight gain, post-pregnancy weight, stress eating.
TREATMENT_KB.procedure: Body composition analysis → Doctor consultation → Customized diet plan → Technology sessions → Regular follow-up
TREATMENT_KB.results: Initial changes in 3–4 weeks; significant results in 8–12 weeks
TREATMENT_KB.cannotTake: Pregnancy, uncontrolled diabetes, severe cardiac conditions (doctor decision required)

faq.a: With proper lifestyle modifications and maintenance plan, weight regain is significantly minimized. We provide full lifestyle counseling.
Our doctor and dietician design a practical, balanced plan suited to your lifestyle — not extreme crash diets.

TREATMENT_KB.name: CoolSculpting (Cryolipolysis)
TREATMENT_KB.purpose: Non-surgical fat freezing treatment that permanently destroys stubborn localized fat cells.
TREATMENT_KB.suitableFor: Individuals with stubborn fat pockets in abdomen, flanks, arms, thighs, double chin. Not for obesity.
TREATMENT_KB.procedure: Cooling applicator placed on target area → Fat cells frozen at -9°C → Cells naturally eliminated over 2–8 weeks
TREATMENT_KB.recovery: Immediate return to activity; minor redness/numbness for 1–2 hours
TREATMENT_KB.results: Visible body sculpting change in 3–4 weeks; final results at 8–12 weeks
TREATMENT_KB.cannotTake: Cryoglobulinemia, cold agglutinin disease, Raynaud's disease, pregnancy

faq.a: CoolSculpting reduces inches and fat, not necessarily scale weight. It is a sculpting treatment, not a weight-loss solution.

TREATMENT_KB.name: GFC Hair Treatment
TREATMENT_KB.purpose: Growth Factor Concentrate — advanced hair regeneration therapy using your own pure growth factors.
TREATMENT_KB.suitableFor: Hair fall in men and women, early to moderate baldness, thinning hair, post-pregnancy hair loss.
TREATMENT_KB.procedure: Blood drawn → GFC processed (30 min) → Applied to scalp via micro-injections → Session 45–60 min
TREATMENT_KB.recovery: Normal activities same day; wash hair next day
TREATMENT_KB.results: Hair fall reduces after 2–3 sessions; new growth visible at 3–4 months
TREATMENT_KB.cannotTake: Active scalp infections, blood clotting disorders

faq.a: GFC delivers purer, higher-concentration growth factors than PRP, resulting in faster and more potent hair growth stimulation.

TREATMENT_KB.name: Hair Transplant (FUE)
TREATMENT_KB.purpose: Permanent surgical restoration of natural hairline by relocating permanent hair follicles from the donor zone.
TREATMENT_KB.suitableFor: Permanent baldness (Norwood Scale 2–6), stable donor zone, healthy overall health.
TREATMENT_KB.procedure: Pre-surgical blood tests → Donor zone shaving → Follicle extraction (FUE punch) → Graft storage → Implantation → Post-op care
TREATMENT_KB.recovery: 2–5 days mild swelling; return to light work in 5–7 days
TREATMENT_KB.pain: Local anesthesia — minimal discomfort during; mild soreness after
TREATMENT_KB.results: New growth from 3rd month; full high-density results at 9–12 months
TREATMENT_KB.cannotTake: Active scalp infections, insufficient donor zone, uncontrolled BP or diabetes, bleeding disorders

faq.a: Yes — transplanted follicles are DHT-resistant and grow permanently in their new location.
Yes, for frontal receding or traction alopecia. Doctor evaluation required.

TREATMENT_KB.name: HydraFacial
TREATMENT_KB.purpose: Premium multi-step medical facial combining cleansing, exfoliation, extraction, and intense hydration.
TREATMENT_KB.suitableFor: All skin types. Dull skin, dehydration, blackheads, early aging signs, uneven tone.
TREATMENT_KB.procedure: Cleanse → Exfoliate → Acid peel (gentle) → Suction extraction → Serum infusion → Protection
TREATMENT_KB.sessions: Single session for glow; monthly for maintenance
TREATMENT_KB.results: Visible brightness and glow immediately after session
TREATMENT_KB.cannotTake: Active rosacea, open wounds, sunburned skin

faq.a: Typically 3–4 weeks. Monthly sessions maintain consistent skin quality.

TREATMENT_KB.name: Laser Hair Reduction (LHR)
TREATMENT_KB.purpose: Long-lasting reduction and permanent removal of unwanted body and facial hair using advanced Diode Laser.
TREATMENT_KB.suitableFor: Any body part — face, underarms, bikini, legs, arms, back. All skin tones.
TREATMENT_KB.procedure: Skin assessment → Patch test (first visit) → Laser applied in grid pattern → Cooling gel → Session 15–60 min
TREATMENT_KB.recovery: Mild redness for 1–2 hours; normal activity same day
TREATMENT_KB.pain: Mild snapping sensation; cooling system minimizes discomfort
TREATMENT_KB.results: Progressive hair reduction with each session; 85–90% permanent reduction after full course
TREATMENT_KB.cannotTake: Pregnancy, active skin infection on treatment area, certain photosensitizing medications

faq.q: Can I wax during the sessions?
faq.a: No — waxing must be avoided during the course. Shaving is allowed and recommended between sessions.
